biography: Tom Sibley, a name quickly gaining traction in the British motorsport scene, hails from a small market town in Oxfordshire. His passion for speed ignited early, fueled by weekend trips to Silverstone with his father. Unlike many of his peers who began karting in their youth, Tom's entry into racing was unconventional. He spent his teens tearing up local banger racing circuits, a baptism by fire that instilled in him a fearlessness and car control that belies his age. A chance encounter with a Ginetta team manager at a local car show led to a test drive and, subsequently, a spot in the Ginetta Junior Championship. While his debut was rocky, marked by a spectacular crash at Brands Hatch, Tom quickly found his footing, showcasing raw talent and a willingness to push the limits. Now at 26, Sibley is a rising star in the Ginetta GT4 SuperCup, his flamboyant style and aggressive maneuvers both thrilling and polarizing. He's currently aiming to leverage his success into a full-time professional career, hoping to one day compete on the international stage.
drivingStyle: Sibley's driving style is best described as 'all-out attack.' He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to throw the car into corners, often flirting with the edge of control. While this aggressive approach has yielded impressive results, it has also led to costly mistakes. Tire management is an area where he struggles, often sacrificing longevity for short bursts of speed. Under pressure, Sibley tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes to his detriment, making him a captivating but unpredictable presence on the track.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial incident at Oulton Park where Thorne accused Sibley of intentionally blocking him during qualifying.
A fierce on-track battle for championship points in the Ginetta GT4 SuperCup, with both drivers known for their uncompromising racing styles.
Bell, a veteran driver, has publicly criticized Sibley's 'reckless' driving, leading to heated exchanges in the paddock.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to a specific heavy metal song ('Highway to Hell') immediately before getting into the car.
Insists on having a cup of tea with exactly two sugars before every qualifying session.
famousQuote: "If you're not on the edge, you're taking up too much space."
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Junior Championship race at Donington Park in 2018 after starting from the back of the grid following a mechanical issue.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 Ginetta GT4 SuperCup race at Brands Hatch, costing him valuable championship points.
